settings.settings_source: items: E268's seven built items (experiments/kstar_needed/results/predictions.json settings.built; tab:built's five copy24 edits and its two shared randoms), ordered so that --shard I 4 gives each of four pods one 41-position item (x2, x10, rebuilt, random_size_241001, ~1,445 s each in E268) and the 512-window items (~510 s) fill in; the do-nothing is read in stage 0. control: E268's. rescan: new_thin, the thin new edit the cell is about and the cheapest scan (505 s in E268). derangements, examples, seed, rows, logit_rows, cache_batch, ident_vars: E268's filed values, unchanged, so the adjoint K is found by the same scan as the least-squares K. gain_batch: E247's write pass batch (experiments/thin_edit_diagnosis/run.py, E242's gain_batch 8), whose num, den, dd E268 scored. repro_rel_tol: E298's largest measured VPD reproduction deviation of E_b_K on an H100, 1.0e-4 relative (experiments/fig2_standard/results/stage0/vpd_repro_trained__elicit_s0_r0.json, 10 K members differing; on built items 5.9e-10 for x2 with K identical, 4.0e-10 for head_v2 with 7 differing). A write pass over a fixed K should sit far below it; the bar is only there to stop the job if the least-squares path changed.

readings.E_b_K: rho at VPD: commute.stand_in.explained_share(num, den, dd, K and changed), num, den, dd from stand_in.write_change over every position of D in F's own run, K by commute.needed.needed_set on the same featurization. 1 when K has no changed member. Blind to how much each variable matters for the behaviour (it weighs by write change). Positive control: the do-nothing (1 exactly) and the gain edits x2 and x10, which are built by scaling existing copy neurons and so should be explained by gains
readings.E_b_over_E268_K: adjoint arm only: the same share over E268's least-squares K: the split's effect on the write share with the variable set held fixed
readings.size_K, size_K_E268, size_both, n_change: |K| under the arm's split, |K| of E268, their overlap, the changed variables, and K's changed members
readings.shares_of_dW2: kstar_vpd.norm_shares total: the summed write side, read side, outside part (the remainder's dW_out) and the two cross terms as shares of |delta-W|^2 over the 24 matrices. Under the unscaled adjoint split K(dW) need not equal dW in size, so the outside share says how much of the update the remainders carry

split_choice: The adjoint split is used unscaled (c = 1). split.adjoint_scale's c = argmin ||(c K(M) - M) Sigma^1/2||_F needs each matrix's input second moments Sigma on some data, and the docstring notes K depends on the gauge of (U_A, V_A), which the release fixes. Scaling would add a fitted, data-dependent number per matrix to the featurization; the cell asks for the adjoint split itself, with the remainder taking the rest so the weights sum to F (kstar_vpd._pieces). Since every piece sums to delta-W exactly either way, c only moves change between the subcomponents and the remainders, which shares_of_dW2 reports.

rules.R0a: Stage 0 stops the job unless the do-nothing (F = M) has, under each split, no changed variable, every dd exactly 0.0 and E_b exactly 1.0
rules.R0b: Stage 0 stops the job on any argmax change under the identity interchange (x' = x) on x2's first 64 windows under the adjoint featurization (three subcomponents and the remainder of every matrix, all 41 read positions); its largest logit deviation is recorded, not barred
rules.R0c: Stage 0 stops the job unless, for every item, a fresh least-squares write pass scored over E268's saved K gives E268's E_b_K within repro_rel_tol relative. Stage 1 stops the job the same way unless new_thin's rescanned least-squares E_b_K is within repro_rel_tol of E268's
rules.items: descriptive, no rule: no verdict under either wording until the user adopts one (CLAUDE.md, P1.1); rivals in the card
